alignments.note: Auxiliary verb הֶרֶב whose contribution the ASV writes as the adverb thoroughly (rule 56). Variant unit is underdetermined and unmarked; no decision taken.

variant_decisions.evidence: ASV 'Wash me thoroughly' renders the word adverbially; the qere imperative הֶרֶב ('multiply [to wash]') and the ketiv infinitive absolute הרבה ('abundantly') both yield 'thoroughly' in English, with no italic supply and no textual note on the verse. The English cannot distinguish the form; base (qere) fallback carries the projection.
